Context: 12. Commutation of Pension

4. Commutation after medical examination.The following categories of pensioners can commute a portion of their pension only after they have been medically examined and declared fit by the appropriate medical authority:-
- (i)
- (ii)
- (iii)
- retired on invalidation;
- retired compulsorily as a measure of penalty;
- in receipt of compassionate allowance; and
- (iv) all pensioners applying for commutation after one year from the date of retirement. - Rule 18.
